mapper.sql: id, review_cycle_id, question_id, question_role, review_status, attempt_count, last_quality, last_attempt_at, passed_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from review_cycle_questions where review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId} and review_status = 'RETRY' order by last_attempt_at desc nulls last, id desc limit 1
select from review_cycle_questions where review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId} and question_role = 'ORIGINAL' and review_status = 'PENDING' order by random() limit 1

select from review_cycle_questions where review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId} and question_role = 'DERIVED' and review_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') order by case when review_status = 'RETRY' then 0 else 1 end, last_attempt_at desc nulls last, id desc limit 1

select question.id, question.review_cycle_id, question.question_id, question.question_role, question.review_status, question.attempt_count, question.last_quality, question.last_attempt_at, question.passed_at, question.sort_order, question.created_at, question.updated_at from review_attempts attempt inner join review_cycle_questions question on question.id = attempt.review_cycle_question_id where attempt.review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId} and attempt.result = 'FAIL' and question.question_role = 'ORIGINAL' order by attempt.created_at desc, attempt.id desc limit 1
select from review_cycle_questions where review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId} order by sort_order, id

select count(*) filter (where question_role = 'ORIGINAL')::integer as original_question_count, count(*) filter (where question_role = 'ORIGINAL' and review_status = 'PASSED')::integer as original_passed_count, count(*) filter (where review_status = 'RETRY')::integer as retry_question_count, count(*) filter (where review_status = 'PENDING')::integer as pending_question_count, count(*) filter (where review_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY'))::integer as active_question_count, count(*) filter (where question_role = 'DERIVED')::integer as derived_question_count, count(*) filter ( where question_role = 'DERIVED' and review_status = 'PASSED' and passed_at > #{verificationRequiredAfter} )::integer as verified_derived_passed_count from review_cycle_questions where review_cycle_id = #{reviewCycleId}
mapper.update: update review_cycle_questions set review_status = #{reviewStatus}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, last_quality = #{lastQuality}, last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, passed_at = #{passedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update review_cycle_questions set review_status = 'RETRY', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, last_quality = 2, last_attempt_at = #{attemptedAt}, passed_at = null, updated_at = #{attemptedAt} where id = #{id}
